content: The shipping container sat in orchestration of a brass band; the cutover of the parade was noon.
A lunch container, an orchestration of salads, and a cutover from forks to spoons.
The recycling container and the orchestration of bins missed the cutover to compost.
A container of crayons, an orchestration of colors, and a cutover of art class.
The leftover container in the fridge, an orchestration of leftovers, a cutover of menus.
A storage container of cables, an orchestration of labels, and a cutover of shelves.
The picnic container, an orchestration of blankets, and the cutover of the park gate.
